Permission rule.d: A line in a Claude Code settings file, such as Bash(npm run test *) or Read(./.env), placed in an allow, ask or deny list. Claude Code checks deny, then ask, then allow before any tool runs.

Settings precedence.d: The order that decides which Claude Code settings file wins when they disagree: managed, then command line, then project local, then shared project, then user. Lists of rules are combined rather than replaced.

Workspace trust.d: The dialog Claude Code shows the first time you open a folder. A project's allow rules and extra directories only take effect after you accept it.

Sandbox.d: In Claude Code, a boundary enforced by the operating system around the shell commands Claude runs, limiting which files they can write and which network hosts they can reach.

Frontmatter.d: A block of settings in YAML between two --- lines at the very top of a Markdown file, such as a SKILL.md. It holds fields like name and description.

Dynamic context injection.d: In a Claude Code skill, a line such as !`git diff HEAD` that runs a command before Claude reads the skill and replaces the line with the command's output.
